summary: LN-034 (uji ulang SKU existing per supplier) tested end to end. Backend: the existing test_l03_ln034_revalidation (4/4) passes on the public URL, and the new edge test file passes 4/4. UI as admin and md: form for existing SKU (chip, picker, supplier KNSelect, reason, eligibility panel, save enabled only when all fields are filled) → reval-box shows supplier, cycle and reference → round set to assessed in Mongo → reval-decide-modal (pass is blocked when there is no ACC, a fail note under 5 characters is blocked) → status 'Gagal — menunggu PIC', cancel button hidden → pic-decision-modal retest creates cycle 2 with a reference to the failed cycle → pic-queue-panel row and Buka work → md sees override disabled ('tidak berizin') → admin override records the result as still GAGAL, eligibility shows 'Gagal — override PIC', queue goes back to 0. sample-decision-box does not show for revalidation. No contract was created. The core flow works. Several UI copy/state issues were found: a failed revalidation is labelled 'Pemenang dipilih'.

minor.issue: md gets 403 from approval matrix sample_acc ('hanya Manager atau Direksi/Admin'), but the UI (canDecide includes md) shows the active 'Catat hasil uji ulang' button to md. Recording a technical result for revalidation (no price/contract) arguably should not go through the 'ACC Sample' gate; otherwise hide the button for md.

Not scoped to entity or to external suppliers: it returns the 6 internal PT supplier records (entity_id ent_*), including duplicates (e.g. 'Sukacita Textile' x2, 'Kanda Fabric' x2, 'CV Cipta Sandang Textile' x2, some from other entities). Filter to entity_id in ('all', active entity) and/or exclude internal PTs, or dedupe.

ui_bugs.issue: After a PIC decision on a FAILED revalidation (status=decided), the status pill reads 'Pemenang dipilih' and stepper step '5. Pemenang' is highlighted. This contradicts 'hasil tetap GAGAL'. Use a revalidation-specific label (e.g. 'Gagal — diputus PIC' / 'Lulus') when purpose=revalidation.
ui_bugs.selector: status pill in sample detail header

ui_bugs.issue: For revalidation samples (pending_pic and decided-fail) it shows a green-check row 'ACC sampling → kontrak & barang supplier: Pemenang <supplier> · Rp 0 · Kontrak otomatis nonaktif — buat manual di Pembelian'. Before the decision it reads 'menunggu keputusan pemenang (tombol Pilih pemenang)'. This contradicts the 'no winner/no contract' rule; hide or reword it for purpose=revalidation. Also the 'Belum ada spesifikasi … SKU produk tidak bisa lahir saat ACC' warning with a 'Lengkapi spesifikasi' button is irrelevant for an existing SKU.

Hidden scope state leaks into the request: if the user fills pic-scope-documents/pic-scope-note under operational_note/override and then switches to retest (the fields are hidden), the documents are still sent and shown in reval-box-pic ('Uji ulang … · dokumen: PO-00012, MKO-00004'). Send scope only when action !== 'retest', or clear it on switch.
The 'Pemenang dipilih' KPI (rnd-samples-kpi-decided) counts failed revalidation samples that PIC decided (showed 2 with 0 real winners).

issues: The 'Sample jadi' action stays visible after pending_pic/decided (disabled-looking). Consider hiding it.

action_items: Use a revalidation-aware status label and stepper for status=decided (do not show 'Pemenang dipilih' for a fail result); exclude revalidation from the 'Pemenang dipilih' KPI.
Hide or reword the SampleMasterDataPanel 'ACC sampling → kontrak … Pemenang' row and the 'Belum ada spesifikasi' warning for purpose=revalidation.
Fix the md mismatch: either let md record the revalidation technical result (skip/adjust the sample_acc matrix guard for purpose=revalidation) or hide sample-decide-button for md.
Scope /api/rnd/revalidation/partners to external suppliers and the active entity (exclude/dedupe internal PT supplier records).
PicDecisionModal: do not submit scope documents/note when action=retest.
critical_code_review_comments: rnd_revalidation_service.lookup_partners filters only on status != inactive, with no entity scope; internal PT duplicates leak into the picker.
SampleDetailPanel computes canDecide = [admin, manager, md], but the backend amx.guard('sample_acc') denies md. Front-end permissions are out of sync with the approval matrix.

decide() accepts only in_progress/assessed, while the front-end 'active' state also covers draft/sent. This is OK because hasResult gates it, but the error message for a stale state ('baru saja diputus pengguna lain') is misleading when the sample is in draft/sent.
seed_data_creation: Created KSC/SMP-00129 and 00130 (prod_lurik_classic × CV Grey Mandiri Majalaya) via the UI and API and set rounds directly in Mongo. All were deleted afterwards, along with the rnd_test_history pull. Pytest files clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LN-034 UI flow verified with admin and md on ?view=rnd-samples&entity=ent_ksc. ProductSelect items use product-select-item-<pid>; KNSelect searchable uses existing-sku-supplier-search and existing-sku-supplier-option-<id>. External supplier example: sup_e3280c5bf71d (CV Grey Mandiri Majalaya). md cannot POST /decide (approval matrix sample_acc), so use admin. Retest the label/master-panel fixes after a frontend rebuild (CI=false yarn build).
